result.summary: The interface is well-structured with no critical visual bugs, though some minor asset and contrast improvements can be made.

issues.description: Placeholder text inside the search bar has relatively low contrast against the light grey field background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text to meet WCAG AA contrast guidelines.

issues.description: Restaurant card imagery uses mixed flat and illustrated vector placeholders rather than consistent food photography.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image styles across restaurant cards with consistent real photography.
